name: GTR_sym
title: The GTR exchangeability matrix

args.name: sym
args.description: Relative exchangeabilities, keyed by unordered letter pair

description: Symmetric matrix with a separate relative exchangeability for each unordered pair of letters. Pair keys concatenate the letters, such as AC or CA; supply one entry per pair. Combine with F to supply equilibrium frequencies, or FE for equal frequencies.
